NIT Hamirpur Secures 35th Rank Among Top Engineering Colleges in India in the IIRF Rankings 2026

Prof. H. M. Suryawanshi, Director, NIT Hamirpur (HP), congratulated Ms. Ridhi Sharma, Dr. Priya Kaushal, and Dr. Gargi Khanna from the Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering, NIT Hamirpur, for receiving the Best Paper Award for their paper titled: “Interface Trap Charge Effects in Si-Doped MoS₂ TFETs: Performance and Robustness Analysis”, presented at the 68th Annual IETE Convention on “Innovative Digital Technologies & Applications for Sustainable Society Development (ITDASSD 2025)”.

Prof. H. M. Suryawanshi, Director, NIT Hamirpur (HP), congratulated Mr. Arihant Raj Siddarth, Dr. Priya Kaushal, and Dr. Gargi Khanna from the Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering, NIT Hamirpur, for being granted U.S. Patent No. US12356670B1, titled: “High Mobility Transistor with AlGaN Buffer Layer.”

Prof. H. M. Suryawanshi, Director, NIT Hamirpur (HP), congratulated Ms. Shambhavi Dogra and Dr. Gargi Khanna from the Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering, NIT Hamirpur, for receiving the Best Paper Award for their paper titled: “Neuromorphic Prosthetic Hand Control Using Spiking Neural Networks and SVM Classifier”, presented at the 3rd International Conference on Women Researchers in Electronics and Computing (WREC-2025), held at NIT Jalandhar during April 18–19, 2025.

Prof. Hiralal Murlidhar Suryawanshi, Director NITH, Congratulated Dr. RK Jarial, Dr. Jiwanjot Singh & Dr. Upasna Sarma, Department of Electrical Engineering for granting a prestigious project titled “Development of high-power Grid-friendly Conductive and Static Wireless Chargers for Electric Vehicles”

Prof. Hiralal Murlidhar Suryawanshi, Director NIT Hamirpur congratulated Dr. Mohd. Adil, Associate Professor of Management Studies Department for being granted a patent for their invention titled “ An autonomous secure method to control counterfeiting in the aviation supply chain using blockchain technology” by the Patent Office, Government of India.
Dr. Tapas Pilai, Dept. of Chemical Engineering has been Granted a Patent "A METHOD FOR SYNTHESIZING AMINE FUNCTIONALIZED POLYMER MEMBRANE FOR ELECTROCHEMICAL REDUCTION OF CO2 TO HYDROCARBONS"
Prof. Hiralal Murlidhar Suryawanshi, Director NITH, Congratulated Dr. Preeti Puri, on the successful granting of the project “Socio-Economic Empowerment of Women through Localized Entrepreneurship"

Prof. H.M. Suryawanshi, Director NIT Hamirpur HP & Dr. Vijay Kr. Bansal Head of the Civil Engineering Department congratulated Mr. Shourya (Roll No: 22BCE099) B.Tech 2nd Year student of the Civil Engineering Department Participated in the CESAFIESTA 2.0 Symposium, held at IIT Ropar on March 09 and 10, 2024.He has been awarded for the best oral presentation and outstanding performance in water resource/Geomatics/Environment Engineering for a project titled "Development of an Advanced Groundwater Monitoring System for Sustainable Resource Management" under the guidance of Dr. Ray Singh Meena, Assistant Professor (Gr-I) Civil Engineering Department NIT Hamirpur
